title: Carl Roth GmbH + Co. KG
content:
Carl Roth is a major European laboratory and specialty materials distributor with a broad catalog for research and industrial users. The company offers aerogel-related materials through its established distribution and catalog-supply network.

  • Coverage Area: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and wider Europe
  • Focus Areas: Laboratory chemicals, research materials, specialty porous materials, and aerogel products for scientific and technical use
  • Current Brands Represented: ROTH catalog products and sourced specialty aerogel materials
  • Official Website: https://www.carlroth.com/
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
